1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 Nf6 5..strategy: Inserts a check first so that the knight can go to f5 instead of retreating. White gives up the clamp with c4, because Black gains time with queenside moves, and plays for the f5 outpost instead.
1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 Nf6 5..name: Sicilian Defence: Prins Variation, Venice Attack
